reviews.title: Pop Ups
reviews.text:
I have used instasize since 2016 on and off. And it’s like since 2020 there have been an INSANE amount of pop-ups begging you to get a subscription. And they are always so impossible to navigate out of and can be extremely misleading. There have been times where it’s offered me a free trial, only to immediately charge my card requiring me to file for a dispute. The only way to use this app is to close 56 different tabs, after looking for the “X” or “Skip” option for another hour. 

Insane work.
